test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: General Election to the Legislative Assembly of which of the following States did not take place in February-March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Legislative assembly elections were conducted in** five states** of India -**Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, **Uttarakhand**, Manipur and Goa **during February-March 2022.
 
• The** Rajasthan **legislative assembly election is scheduled to be held in or before **December 2023**.
 
• New Chief Ministers of the above-mentioned states are (Sept 2022)
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh- **Yogi Adityanath**
 
• Punjab- ** ****Bhagwant Singh Mann**
 
• Uttarakhand- **Pushkar Singh Dhami**
 
• Manipur- **N. Biren Singh**
 
• Goa- **Pramod Sawant**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• BJP candidate **Droupadi Murmu** became the **15th President of India** defeating **Yashwant Sinha.** 

 
 
• She is the **first tribal and second woman** to do so.
 
• She is the **youngest President of India**.
 
 
 
• **Jagdeep Dhankhar** became the **Vice President of India** replacing **Venkaiah Naidu**.
 
 
• Prior to that Jagdeep Dhankhar was serving as **Governor of West Bengal.**
